Your lift cable snaps on the 40th floor. 3 things save you, and the third one is you 😱

Lifts hang on 4 to 8 cables, and each one can hold the lift alone: more backup plans than an Indian mummy. Falling too fast? Safety brakes grab the rails. And jumping at the last second? Myth: your best jump cancels only a few km/h. The real move: press the alarm, stay inside, wait.

Did you know lifts have up to 8 cables? Comment YES or NO.

A lift hangs on 4 to 8 steel cables, and each one alone can hold the car. If it still falls too fast, a speed governor trips safety brakes that grab the guide rails. Jumping at the last second is a myth: your best jump cancels only a few km/h, so if a lift stops, press the alarm, stay inside and wait for help.
